paragraphs: The Flemish Militia is the Burgundians' unique infantry unit. Flemish Revolution transforms existing villagers into soldiers, turning an economy into an army for a decisive push.

Flemish Militia are especially strong against mounted units, but ranged soldiers can exploit their lack of reach. Their strength comes from closing the distance and bringing their anti-cavalry attacks to bear.
These equal-resource battles test how the militia fares against the game's unique units, from heavy cavalry to archers and siege weapons.
